label: The Titan

boxBlock._verified: extractBoxBlock() run against the real file: anchor occurs exactly ONCE (Step_0:153) and slices to 415 chars — the growtangle if plus its internal if/else, nothing more.
boxBlock._note: Step_0:153-159. Choices 2/3/4 (the big-blast attacks) get the box at view+(250,200); every other choice gets view+(320,170), because the blasts are fired from obj_growtangle.x + 240 and need room to cross. The whole block already sits inside `if (myattackchoice == 20) { } else { ... }` (Step_0:148-163), so a heal turn creates NO box at all (and Step_0:61 likewise skips obj_darkener). maxxscale/maxyscale stay at obj_growtangle's default except types 468 (2.125) and 469 (2.25), which the CONTROLLER sets itself (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:3867-3871, 3893-3897) — the studio gets those for free by actually spawning the controller.

turnBlock._verified: extractTurnBlock() run against the real file: first `scr_turntimer(360);` is Step_0:175, passes the /turntimer/ proximity test on its own text, and the endAnchor slices to 105 chars (Step_0:175-178).
turnBlock._note: The base turn length is 360 for EVERY Titan attack including the choice-20 heal turn (Step_0:175 runs before any choice test). The `if (myattackchoice == 2) scr_turntimer(270)` that follows is a NO-OP because scr_turntimer only raises (scr_turntimer.gml:2-3) and 360 was set one line earlier — the same fossil as Spamton NEO's 90-after-260. The endAnchor is MANDATORY: this ladder has no trailing `else scr_turntimer(N);`, the only terminator extractTurnBlock recognises unaided, and without it the slice would run through the whole dispatcher and spawn a second obj_dbulletcontroller every turn (the Knight bug). Per-attack overrides live INSIDE each dispatcher branch and therefore ride along in each entry's `setup`: 420 for choices 0/14/15, 430 for choice 3, a direct `global.turntimer = 240` for the cut choice 13. Controller-side raises to 420 also exist for types 451/455/457/464/470 (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:3551, 3643, 3684, 3803, 3930), which is why choices 1/5/12 read 420 with silent branches. ONE override is not capturable: `if (myattackchoice == 4 && phase == 8) global.turntimer = 240;` (Step_0:319-320) sits after `turns += 1`, outside every branch, and needs phase 8 — the studio will run choice 4 at 360. Termination depends on all this: obj_darkshape_manager_Step_0.gml:3-7 destroys itself the moment global.turntimer <= 0.

_scopeNote: `choice` numbers live in TWO separate namespaces. Entries with scope "titan" are obj_titan_enemy.myattackchoice; entries with scope "spawn" are obj_titan_spawn_enemy.myattackchoice — a DIFFERENT encounter (scr_encountersetup.gml:1164-1181, case 177) that shares obj_dbulletcontroller. The same choice number means different types in each. Key any downstream real/cut judge on `type`, not on `choice`: realTypes/cutTypes below are the deduped, unambiguous form.

mechanics: RED soul, plain rectangular box, NO green/purple/yellow modes and NO minigame or turn-replacement turns. The one non-bullet turn is choice 20, which just plays obj_titan_heal. The fight is a LIGHT-vs-DARK attrition puzzle: obj_darkshape bullets home in on the SOUL, and loitering inside obj_darkshape_light_aura (radius tracks obj_titan_enemy.light_radius, default 48, raised by the 10-TP Brighten ACT — obj_darkshape_light_aura_Create_0.gml:1-8) burns a shape's `light` to 1 and kills it into an obj_darkshape_greenblob (obj_darkshape_Create_0.gml:99-104) that pays TENSION scaled by obj_titan_enemy.tensionscaling. That scaling ramps 1 -> 1.5 -> 2 -> 3 after 4, 5 and 7 turns without an UNLEASH (Step_0:74-81), so stalling hands you the 200 TP. Stats: HP 21000, AT 18, DF 0 (scr_monstersetup.gml:2027-2035); ACTs Check / Brighten 10 TP / DualHeal 40 TP / Unleash 200 TP (:2043-2059). Damage model (obj_heroparent_Step_0.gml:361-390, mirrored for spells in scr_spell.gml:143-150): x0.5 while shielded, x0.1 in drawstate 'defense', x5 on the exposed weak point — x10 with weapon 26 or 11 — all times unleashmultiplier. PHASE LADDER (chooser Other_10 plus the UNLEASH resolution at Step_0:1967-2018, which does `phaseturn = 1; event_user(0); phaseturn = 0;`): phase 1 loops {0,12,9}; UNLEASH -> phase 2 {4, then 1 which flips to phase 3}; phase 3 loops {1,14,10}; UNLEASH -> phase 4 {4, then 5 which flips to phase 5}; phase 5 loops {5,15,11}; UNLEASH -> phase 6 {3 once, then 4 forever} with unleashmultiplier ramping 1.2/1.2/2/3 (Other_10.gml:159-171) and the UNLEASH ACT removed from the menu (Step_0:2005-2011). Phases 2 and 4 set deunleash = true on their last turn (Other_10.gml:56, :119), which clears `unleashed` at Step_0:338-346 so UNLEASH is available again. Because `unleashed` stays true throughout phases 2/4/6 and is cleared only by deunleash — by which point `phase` has already moved on — the unleash-switch arms `phase == 2 -> 4` (Step_0:1975), `phase == 4 -> 6` (:1983) and `phase == 6 -> 6` (:1997) are UNREACHABLE; the real ladder is 1->2, 3->4, 5->6, and in phases 2/4/6 the ACT falls into the refusal at Step_0:1936-1944. HP <= 50% fires finalunleashphasedone (Step_0:25-49): cutscene chain endingcon 1..3 puts the fight in phase 7 (three choice-20 heal turns interleaved with endingcon 4 and 8 dialogue); the endingcon 8..22.5 chain opens phase 8 and grants the DualBuster ACT (Step_0:1269-1299); endingcon 23..27 sets afterdualbusterused and endingcon 29..34 grants Susie's Idea, which ends the fight via obj_titan_throwkris (Step_0:1687-1728). CROSS-TURN STATE: the hands attacks persist broken fingers on the boss as hand1_finger1..4 / hand2_finger1..4 and re-destroy them on every later hands turn (obj_titan_battle_hands_manager_Create_0.gml:82-146, 205-269) — a fresh studio launch always starts with all eight intact. obj_titan_spawn_enemy is a SEPARATE, EARLIER encounter (scr_encountersetup.gml case 177 vs the Titan's case 175; monstertype 109, 'TITAN SPAWN - AT 30 DF 200'), two instances at once with only the first as battlecontroller (Create_0.gml:4-5), ended by the Banish ACT (scr_monstersetup.gml:2098; obj_titan_spawn_enemy_Step_0.gml:313-314 -> scr_wincombat). obj_titan_enemy_actor is NOT an enemy: a visual stand-in with no battle code whose siner the boss copies before destroying it (obj_titan_enemy_Create_0.gml:129-135). DEAD CODE worth knowing: first_barrage is set true in all three Creates and never cleared, so all seventeen `if (!creatorid.first_barrage)` barrage overrides in obj_dbulletcontroller are unreachable; attack_chooser = 6, handattackhardcon (set at Other_10.gml:91) and unleash_hp/unleash_hpmax (reset at Other_10.gml:57, :120) are written but never read anywhere in chapter 4; pattern_bigshots_easy (obj_darkshape_manager_Create_0.gml:495) is defined and never referenced.
engineNeeds: 1) obj_darkshape_manager stores its attack pattern as an INSTANCE-VARIABLE FUNCTION (`pattern_to_use = function() {...}`, invoked every step from Step_0:10) — the transpiler needs first-class GML function values on instances, default-argument functions (finger_vector, curl_fingers in the hands manager), and tolerance for one function being DEFINED TWICE in a single Create (pattern_centipede_hard at :281 and :994; the later must win, and it is the one types 455 and 470 actually get). 2) Three referenced patterns are never defined at all — pattern_mines (type 458), pattern_mineguys (466), pattern_darkshape_walls (467) — so those branches must fail soft rather than abort the run. 3) obj_titan_battle_hands_manager does surface_create(640, 480) and a 306-line surface-based Draw_0; without render-target support types 459/462/463 draw nothing even though collision still works. 4) Heavy use of the deferred-tween helpers scr_lerpvar, scr_lerpvar_instance, scr_var_delay, scr_var_delayed and scr_lerp_imageblend — the hands attack is almost entirely alarm + lerp choreography (Alarm_0..Alarm_4 plus a Step_2). 5) Termination is driven by global.turntimer: obj_darkshape_manager_Step_0.gml:3-7 destroys itself at turntimer <= 0, so the turn block MUST be replayed or every attack ends on frame one. 6) Types 452/453/454/465 create obj_darkshape_blast_tester at obj_growtangle.x + 260 and every big-blast pattern positions bullets relative to it (obj_darkshape_manager_Create_0.gml:341, 376, 431, 464-472, ...) — it must exist and sit off-screen-right of the box. 7) The patterns reach back into obj_titan_enemy with `with` blocks at fourteen sites (Create_0.gml:362, 389, 416, 452, 469, 541, 615, 715, 718, 756, 759, 878, 919, 922) for chargecon/chargetimer/chargettimermax/chargeshakex and to read `phase` — a boss instance carrying the Create defaults must exist, or those blocks silently no-op and pattern_bigshots_aimed loses its phase-4/6 extra volleys. 8) The light mechanic needs obj_darkshape_light_aura (reads obj_titan_enemy.light_radius) and obj_darkshape_greenblob (reads obj_titan_enemy.tensionscaling) for the TENSION payout. 9) The choice-20 heal turn needs obj_titan_heal, obj_titan_heal_orb and obj_titan_wing_marker, reads global.monstermaxhp, and must be declared by hand since it has no monsterattackname. 10) obj_titan_big_ray and obj_titan_biglaser are fired by pattern_desperation_shots (choice 3) at Create_0.gml:705 and :858-861; obj_darkshape_giant only by the cut type 472. 11) Controller types 466 and 467 exist in obj_dbulletcontroller with NO dispatcher writer anywhere in chapter 4, so they never become roster rows at all; type 471 in the same file belongs to obj_holywatercooler_enemy (Step_0:389), not the Titan. 12) The phase-8 turn-length override and the persistent broken-finger state are the two behaviours a single-attack studio launch cannot reproduce — both are documented above and both are cosmetic-to-mechanical rather than fatal.
